statement: Chinese AI chipmakers including Huawei and Cambricon have raised processor prices because of high-bandwidth memory supply constraints.
why: When memory scarcity is severe enough to force chip price rises, it confirms HBM is the binding bottleneck on accelerator output across the whole chain, not just in China.

impact.mechanism: Tight HBM allocation limits how many accelerator packages can be finished, so memory scarcity passes straight into higher finished-chip prices and constrained shipments.

evidence.excerpt: Chinese AI chipmakers including Huawei and Cambricon have significantly increased prices for their processors due to high-bandwidth memory (HBM) supply constraints.

confidence.basis: Single secondary wire exclusive based on unnamed channel sources; no filings.
